test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_ecs_perf (k UInt32, s String, lc LowCardinality(String), ip4 IPv4) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_ecs_perf SELECT number % 1000, toString(number % 1000), toString(number % 1000), toIPv4(number * 7919) FROM numbers(10000000)
test.query: SELECT estimateCompressedSize('LZ4', 65536)(s) FROM t_ecs_perf FORMAT Null
SELECT estimateCompressedSize('LZ4', 65536, 'LowCardinality(String)')(s) FROM t_ecs_perf FORMAT Null
SELECT estimateCompressedSize('LZ4', 65536, 'LowCardinality(String)')(lc) FROM t_ecs_perf FORMAT Null
SELECT estimateCompressedSize('LZ4', 65536, 'IPv6')(ip4) FROM t_ecs_perf FORMAT Null
SELECT k, estimateCompressedSize('LZ4', 65536)(s) FROM t_ecs_perf GROUP BY k FORMAT Null
SELECT k, estimateCompressedSize('LZ4', 65536, 'LowCardinality(String)')(s) FROM t_ecs_perf GROUP BY k FORMAT Null
SELECT estimateCompressedSize('LZ4', 65536)(s) FROM t_ecs_perf SETTINGS max_block_size = 1000 FORMAT Null
